failure.title: Compose returned literal null for pre-container image inventory
failure.note: After successful image builds, Compose 2.40.3 emitted literal null and the verifier attempted to read Service from it.
failure.diagnosis: The JSON-lines parser assumed every decoded record was a non-null object and used pre-container Compose inventory as the sole image identity source.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
